prompt.en: Who was the first French-Canadian prime minister since Confederation?
prompt.fr: Qui a été le premier premier ministre canadien-français depuis la Confédération?

explanation.en: Sir Wilfrid Laurier became the first French-Canadian prime minister since Confederation and encouraged immigration to the West. His portrait is on the $5 bill.
explanation.fr: Sir Wilfrid Laurier est devenu le premier premier ministre canadien-français depuis la Confédération et a encouragé l'immigration vers l'Ouest. Son portrait figure sur le billet de 5 dollars.

source.quote: Sir Wilfrid Laurier became the first French-Canadian prime minister since Confederation and encouraged immigration to the West. His portrait is on the $5 bill.
